description: Known design-token debt granted a review lifetime. Each entry names the exact file:line and matched text where the debt was accepted, has a reason, and is counted. Matching is by file + matched text so an unrelated edit above an entry does not fail the gate; a new copy of the same text in the same file still needs its own entry. The detectors are shrink-only: a new violation fails, and an entry that no longer matches fails as stale. Reserved tokens are exempt in design/tokens/tokens.json, not here.
